GET *.notes: Serves data/frontend-dist-5c = docker-cp of the container's /app/frontend/dist (per-file md5+mtime equal, so send's size-mtime ETag and Last-Modified agree by construction). Catch-all gate is Node's exact req.path.startsWith('/api') — /apifoo proxies. Node's TLS side (:3443) is inert in the harness (HTTPS_PORT empty — :3443 here is actually PROD bindarr's published port, so the test lane must never bind it); the tls.rs twin (rcgen CN=scrybox, 397 d under Safari's 398-day cap, SAN localhost+127.0.0.1+::1+host NICs, key.pem 0600, reuse-until-expiry, operator key.pem/cert.pem pair never overwritten, error-swallow so HTTPS failure never downs HTTP) is pinned field-for-field against `openssl x509 -text` of the container-generated Node cert, with ONE documented deviation: Node's selfsigned cert is RSA-2048, rcgen's ring backend is ECDSA P-256 (BRIEF prescribes rcgen; RSA would force the aws-lc-rs backend; trust behavior identical). TLS arms verified live on a one-off instance (HTTPS_PORT_B= opt-in in restart-rust-b.sh, bind :3321 + HTTPS_PORT=3444): serves SPA + API over TLS, REUSES Node's own cert pair from <db dir>/ssl = data/ssl = the container's /app/database/ssl (served DER md5-identical to file; CN=bindarr reuse proves the load ladder), HSTS correctly ABSENT there (selfSignedTls truthy twin) and correctly PRESENT on the HTTPS-off harness instance (both sides, dump-pinned). Fixed from the WIP this iter: SPA wildcard was /*rest (axum 0.8 PANIC at router build — the mount had never served a request) and the shared express_json/express_default_404 twins stamped CT,ETag,CL / CT,CSP,CL where Node pins CT,CL,ETag / CSP,CT,CL (also repairs the iter-3 scan-assets 500 arm). Honest fleet-wide gap: Node compression@1.8.1 negotiates brotli, Rust twins answer gzip (decoded bodies byte-equal); br negotiation (accepts q-ports) is a follow-up unit.
